title: Kusanagi Nene — Feeling In Each Step〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, I nailed that step sequence.
Next is the turn...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... Like that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! That was awesome, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You looked so cool doing that dance routine!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've finally mastered the dance you practiced with those other girls☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You must've practiced it quite a lot since then.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I ended up working on it until the very last day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I was able to finally get it down after Imura and Mori agreed to join me for a few extra practices.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It sounds like you were able to wrap up your time there in a neat little bow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm really glad that I got to see things through until the very end...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You have this air of resolve now, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Huh? I do...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm also sensing a great deal of determination.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's probably because training at Morinomiya made me realize just how much harder I need to work...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you have been working out super hard lately!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really understand the importance of being fit now. So, I've been training more and changing the exercises I do from time to time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's wonderful! And I feel like exercising now after hearing you talk about your training!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know! Why don't you do something in SEKAI for a change? For starters, we can try sprinting as fast as we can!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure how much I'll benefit from sprinting...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I guess it could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My stamina still leaves a lot to be desired, so I wanna do everything I can to make sure I stick to my workout routine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Do your best!
We'll be cheering like crazy for you☆ You've got this♪
Evening
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've finished my homework and have everything ready for tomorrow... So, I guess I should go to bed now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But it's still way too early.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I had extra time on my hands like this. While I was training at Morinomiya, I always had something to work on...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But now that I'm free, what should I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have those games that I couldn't play because I was so busy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The ones that were updated recently have been on my mind, and... Oh, there's new DLC for this one. Plus, I still haven't touched the latest installment of this series.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, I have been working pretty hard...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm gonna go all out on these tonight...!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, another stage cleared. It's been a while, but I feel like I'm on a roll.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'll keep going until... Wait, huh?
It's already past midnight...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That was close.
I want to train in the morning, so I should probably go to bed now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Train in the morning...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I used to play all night without realizing it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I'm being much more careful now.
I guess that means I've grown up a little...
